Reads playback time in selected YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels, then advances after the configured play count. Long-video skipping uses a known total duration and safety checks. The optional timer advances only Instagram videos without progress information after the selected wait. Long-video, ad and YouTube live-preview options work independently of play count. Main execution off stops everything. A live-preview delay of 0 seconds means skip immediately. Optional visual analysis and capture require Android 14 or later and compare images only in device memory. Videos, accounts and viewing history are not stored or transmitted. This service reads screens and performs swipes. Optional photo-Reel automation reads slide indices and advances individual photos or the whole Reel.
Fully expand Quick Settings, open Edit and add this app’s auto-advance tile. Its system label may follow another language in your system list.

Reads playback time in selected YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels, then swipes after the chosen play count.

Long-video skipping advances after safety checks when a known total duration meets the threshold, without waiting for a new start or completion. Range: 1–3600 seconds; default: 60. Unknown lengths are not guessed.

The optional timer advances only Instagram videos without progress information after the selected wait. Long-video, ad and YouTube live-preview options are independent of play count and also work at 0 plays. Main execution off stops all automation. Live delay is 0–60 seconds; 0 means skip immediately.

On Android 14 or later, separately enabled visual assistance compares Instagram video screens on this device when playback information is unavailable. Initial learning may add extra plays; this experimental feature does not guarantee an exact count. Older Android versions use basic features without screen capture.

Accessibility is a powerful permission that can read and interact with screens and, on Android 14 or later, capture them. Internet access is used only to check for and download GitHub updates. Videos, accounts, viewing history and screens are not stored or transmitted.

On the next screen, open Installed apps and enable this app’s service yourself. Its system label may follow another language in your system list. Do not change other accessibility services. Optional photo-Reel automation reads slide indices and advances individual photos or the whole Reel.

If the timer is also on, it takes priority and your visual-assistance choice is kept.

Enable this experimental feature?

Open YouTube, Instagram or TikTok from the home screen. Enable that app and configure its rules; the bottom switch starts or stops all selected apps. The detail header always identifies the app you are editing. Back returns home without applying typed drafts. Use Done or Apply to save a number; starting execution also validates enabled rules.

1/2 is the first play and 2/2 the second. Starting mid-video waits for a new beginning. Repeat 0 stops ordinary repeats, the unreadable-progress timer and visual analysis. Ads, photos, known long videos and YouTube live previews are separate options and can work at 0. Overall execution off stops everything.

Long-video skipping is off by default. It skips a safely recognized ordinary video with known total duration at least the threshold: 1–3600 seconds, initially 60. This is video length, not a waiting time. Unknown lengths are never guessed.

Instagram and TikTok have separate ad, photo and unreadable-progress options. Ad delay is 0.0–9.9 seconds in 0.1-second steps; 0.0 adds no delay after safety checks. The timer is off by default, initially 3 seconds, adjustable from 2 to 60. Its initial 2-second eligibility check is included. It is a timeout, not an exact play count; readable videos follow their repeat rule.

For recognized photos, choose the whole post or each photo. Both delays are 0–10 seconds, initially 3. The last photo gets the same wait. Optional unreadable-index fallback uses the whole-post delay; otherwise it waits. Ambiguous or mixed-media pages are not guessed. Unconfirmed photo movement stops until execution is restarted.

YouTube live-preview skipping is optional and off by default. Delay 0 means immediately after safety checks; 1–60 seconds adds a wait. Instagram visual analysis is optional, experimental and available on Android 14 or later. The timer takes priority if both are enabled.

Multiple-app mode follows selected visible windows independently, but does not force playback or change app focus. Comments, menus, pauses and unsafe windows wait. A failed move may require Resume this app or overall execution off and on. App updates can change recognition. TikTok special-content and three-app use still need real-device validation.

Internet access is used only for public GitHub updates. Videos, accounts and viewing history are not saved or transmitted. Reconnecting the service leaves execution off for safety.
